canonical_statement: Provisional repository interpretation: for probability measures on compact metric Borel spaces and a lower-semicontinuous nonnegative extended-real cost, there exists a coupling attaining the minimum transport cost.
domain_and_universes: X : Type u, Y : Type v; compact metric Borel spaces; probability measures mu on X and nu on Y; c : X x Y -> ENNReal
hypotheses: compact metric Borel structure on X and Y
conclusion: there exists a transport plan gamma with marginals mu and nu whose cost is no greater than that of every competing transport plan
